svg.desc: Recall at 100 against query latency on a log scale for 100,000 items. IVF climbs from 0.5 recall at nprobe 1 to 0.997 at nprobe 16 while staying far faster than exact search. HNSW needs efSearch 512 to reach 0.99 on user-vector queries, at a higher latency. Exact search is the slowest point at recall 1.
